set.body:
Slice of F05.2 that does not depend on F04.3 (institutional sign-in). Today's bearer-token sign-in stays; F04.3 replaces only the sign-in form.

Scope:
- Sign-in asks only for the credential; a deep link (#/d/..., #/p/...) returns to its target after sign-in.
- Home (#/): labs with their projects, "Shared with you" (/v1/me/shares), and opening by identifier as a fallback.
- Lab (#/l/{id}) and project (#/p/{id}) pages: names, search, paging with Show more, restart on 409, linked datasets marked.
- Dataset pages show "Lab › Project › label" crumbs when the console learned the place from a directory in this tab.
- No memberships, empty projects, an unbootstrapped organization (409) or no organization routes (404), stale or denied links: each has a recovery action.

Verification: demo-transport browser probes (keyboard, focus, 390 px layout, axe) plus the real HTTP/PostgreSQL rehearsal after a genuine operator bootstrap: the owner navigates lab › project › dataset by name; the grant-only colleague sees the empty state.
Not in scope: institutional login and expired sessions (F04.3), and choosing people and recipients (F05.3).
set.title: F05.2.1: Console navigation over the authorized directories (token sign-in)
